database_storage_estimate.estimate_caveat: This conservative planning proxy is not a PostgreSQL measurement or guaranteed upper bound; verify actual database and Neon project usage after import.
database_storage_estimate.formula: 5 times total uncompressed COPY bytes plus 67108864 bytes fixed overhead.
database_storage_estimate.verification_required_after_import: Measure pg_database_size and pg_total_relation_size after loading; confirm the project's actual quota and usage in the Neon dashboard.

selection_policy.arab_country_rows: Retain every job row whose country value matches an Arab League member country or a listed alias.
selection_policy.cross_source_deduplication: Not performed; source rows remain distinct.
selection_policy.non_arab_rows: Retain at most the configured row cap from every (source_dataset, country) stratum. Select deterministically by the smallest SHA-256 ranks of source_dataset, normalized country, and record_id.
selection_policy.unclassified_geography_rows: Retain all rows with a blank country, Other/Unknown, Remote (Anywhere), or Worldwide label in full; their geography is not treated as non-Arab without evidence.

skill_relationship_policy.skill_observations: Recalculate per-source normalized-skill counts from the retained job-skill rows.
